gloss: feeling of isolation; sense of loneliness

definitions.gloss: feeling of isolation; sense of loneliness; sense of being cut off
definitions.explanation: The emotional experience of feeling isolated, disconnected from others, or alone in a social or emotional sense.

examples.japanese: {孤立感|こりつかん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{感|かん}じている→感じる：02044_kanjiru⟧。
⟦{転校|てんこう}→転校：03444_tenkou⟧⟦{後|ご}→後：30157_go⟧、⟦{強|つよ}い→強い：00820_tsuyoi⟧{孤立感|こりつかん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{悩|なや}まされた→悩ます：12602_nayamasu⟧。
examples.english: After transferring schools, I was troubled by a strong sense of isolation.

examples.japanese: ⟦{在宅勤務|ざいたくきんむ}→在宅勤務：06158_zaitakukinmu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{長|なが}く→長い：00491_nagai⟧⟦{続|つづ}く→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦{同僚|どうりょう}→同僚：01023_douryou⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{交流|こうりゅう}→交流：02732_kouryuu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{減|へ}って→減る：01985_heru⟧{孤立感|こりつかん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{抱|かか}え→抱える：02031_kakaeru⟧やすく⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: When remote work continues for a long time, interaction with colleagues decreases and it becomes easy to develop feelings of isolation.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{孤立|こりつ}→孤立：12229_koritsu⟧ (isolation) and ⟦{感|かん}→〜感：28578_kan⟧ (feeling/sense). Describes the subjective emotional experience of being isolated, which may or may not reflect actual social isolation.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {孤立感|こりつかん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{感|かん}じる→感じる：02044_kanjiru⟧: to feel isolated
- {孤立感|こりつかん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{苦|くる}しむ→苦しむ：01938_kurushimu⟧: to suffer from feelings of isolation
- {孤立感|こりつかん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{抱|かか}える→抱える：02031_kakaeru⟧: to harbor feelings of isolation
- {孤立感|こりつかん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{深|ふか}まる→深まる：02406_fukamaru⟧: feelings of isolation deepen

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{疎外感|そがいかん}→疎外感：06938_sogaikan⟧: feeling of alienation — implies being excluded or pushed away by a group
- {寂|さび}しさ: loneliness — a simpler, more everyday word for the emotion of being lonely
- ⟦{孤独感|こどくかん}→孤独感：05995_kodokukan⟧: sense of solitude — emphasizes being alone, whether by choice or circumstance
